provenance.fitted_on: DEV half of public (3,750 rows, query-disjoint from HOLDOUT); HOLDOUT never read
provenance.scalar: x = p_semi + 2*p_rel, sliced by two cuts (lean_infer._ordinal_scalar)
provenance.why_global_not_regime: Per-regime cuts are the pre-registered rule and average about +0.006 across the TY-ecomm family, but on THIS checkpoint the out-of-fold estimate prefers global by 0.0027 (0.8533 vs 0.8506). Two reasons to follow OOF here rather than the prior: (1) OOF is precisely the estimator designed not to reward overfitting the fitting half, and (2) global fits 2 parameters on 3,750 rows whereas per-regime fits 6, the smallest bin holding only 753 rows - strictly more exposure to DEV noise, which is the thing we are most trying to avoid.
